name: Process AgencyDesk approved jobs in dry run

nodes.name: AgencyDesk dry-run worker

parameters.url: ={{ (() => { throw new Error('Configure the verified AgencyDesk automation-dry-run URL and Header Auth credential before running.'); })() }}

nodes.notes: Deployment and owner credential binding required. Header Auth name: x-automation-secret. This request consumes due approved jobs as simulated. Never point it at automation-worker. Do not enable retries.

conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { const b = $json.body; if ($json.statusCode !== 200 || !b || typeof b !== 'object' || Array.isArray(b) || b.mode !== 'dry_run' || !Number.isInteger(b.claimed) || b.claimed < 0 || b.claimed > 5) return false; const p = b.processed; if (!p || typeof p !== 'object' || Array.isArray(p)) return false; const entries = Object.entries(p); return entries.every(([k, v]) => ['simulated', 'skipped'].includes(k) && Number.isInteger(v) && v >= 0) && entries.reduce((sum, [, v]) => sum + v, 0) === b.claimed; })() }}

parameters.errorMessage: AgencyDesk did not confirm a dry-run result. Review the worker and queue before retrying.

parameters.content:
## AgencyDesk: manual approved-job dry run
Unpublished integration draft. No leads, sample data or provider nodes.
1. Owner reviews/merges and deploys automation-dry-run to the verified own AgencyDesk project.
2. Server must explicitly set AUTOMATION_DELIVERY_MODE=dry_run.
3. Owner creates Header Auth credential (name x-automation-secret, dedicated AUTOMATION_N8N_SECRET value) and binds it. No general cron/service-role/sender key.
4. Replace the URL guard with the verified HTTPS function URL ending /automation-dry-run.
5. Authorize a manual batch against the real approved queue; inspect the aggregate result. Simulated jobs are terminal, not later delivery.
No schedule/publish until atomic operating caps and failure handling are verified. Do not auto-retry an uncertain run.
